name: scene.phrases
note: Phrase templates for V39 (DASH.078). Slots in braces are filled from the store; wording follows DB-01 (finding, never violation).
setting.run: Run {scenario} on map {map}. This vessel's record runs from {t0} to {t1} ({dur}).
vessel.role.all: tested, as every vessel in this run
vessel.met: It has encounter records with {n} vessels: {names}.
scene.head: {kind} with {target}, {t0}–{t1}
scene.role.give_way: {vessel} was recorded as the give-way vessel.
scene.role.stand_on: {vessel} was recorded as the stand-on vessel.
scene.role.unknown: Which vessel was to stand on was not recorded.
scene.cpa: The closest approach was not recorded.
scene.outside: This finding names {target} but falls outside its recorded encounters.
scene.collision: A collision with {target} was recorded at {t}.
scene.unjudged.16: Its action as give-way vessel (Rule 16) was not judged.
scene.unjudged.17: The stand-on duty (Rule 17) was not recorded.
scene.rollup: {n} more encounters with {m} vessels had no COLREG finding.
wrong.more: {n} more kinds of finding, {pts} in all.
wrong.none: No findings were recorded for this vessel.
notjudged.16: Rule 16, action by give-way vessel: arose in {n} encounter records; not judged.
notjudged.17: Rule 17, action by stand-on vessel: not recorded; {n} crossing or overtaking records.
notjudged.none: No situation arose that the framework records but does not judge.
result.collision: {n} collisions were recorded, the first with {target} at {t}.
result.grounding: Grounding contact was found {n} times, first at {t}.
